concepts.Emotion Evidence: source-bound observation/reference candidate with evidence, provenance, confidence, uncertainty, and temporal scope
concepts.Emotion Appraisal: candidate interpretation of relevance, expectation, goal relation, risk, or affective meaning; not state truth
concepts.Emotion State: multidimensional candidate containing valence, arousal, activation/intensity, category candidates, context, and validity
concepts.Mood: broader contextual persistence candidate that may contain emotion references; not immutable state or personality truth
concepts.Personality Trait: Personality Governance candidate; emotion is evidence only and cannot activate it
concepts.Self: Self Governance identity/continuity candidate; emotion cannot mutate it
concepts.Memory: Cognitive Memory & Experience historical semantic owner; emotion supplies observation candidates
concepts.Intent: Intent Governance goal-pressure/priority owner; emotion supplies influence candidates only
concepts.Action: downstream action owner; emotion has no execution authority
concepts.External Reality: reality/evidence authority; emotion cannot rewrite facts

anti_flattening_rules: Do not collapse valence, arousal, activation, category, uncertainty, and context into one opaque emotional score.
Do not silently average contradictory evidence into certainty.
Named emotion categories remain candidate semantics and may be revised, superseded, revoked, or expired.
